messages:
lia: Quick weekly health pulse for NovaRetail onboarding 1: error spike last 2 hours. 5xx 3.2% (+1.4ppt), timeouts 1.0% (+0.6ppt), 429s 0.8% (+0.3ppt). Can we surface top failing endpoints? :mag:
maria: Top endpoints by error volume (1h): /v1/chat/stream, /v1/embeddings/batch, /metrics/ingest. 5xx concentrated on chat/stream and embeddings/batch. Sample truncated logs:
```
2026-01-22T11:02:01Z ERROR 502 POST /v1/chat/stream id=ch_z12 lat=1300ms
2026-01-22T11:03:10Z ERROR 504 POST /v1/embeddings/batch job=eb_91 lat=4100ms
```
sam: Runtime change note: we changed batch-worker concurrency defaults in prod two days ago (8 -> 12). That plus customer increasing client parallelism could oversubscribe model pools.
jess: NovaRetail is mid-onboard; renewal flagged if errors >2% sustained. Need a quick mitigation plan for CSM.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: no recent runtime deploys; autoscale events: embeddings-pool scaled +1 at 10:50Z.
maria: Mitigation suggestions: 1) throttle client max batch size at edge for this account, 2) temp bump embeddings pool, 3) ask customer to reduce parallel workers. Which ops/CSM can do fastest?
sam: Ops can bump pool +1 immediately. Edge throttle needs config push (~15m). Jess can message customer.
lia: Do ops bump first and then throttle. Jess, tell customer we're doing a temporary throttle and capacity bump, expect improvement in 20-30m.
jess: Messaging now. Will ask them to pause parallel workers for 1 hour.
sam: Done: embeddings-pool +1 at 11:15Z. Early metrics: embeddings 504s down from 2.9% -> 0.7% in 6m. Chat stream 5xx improved slightly.
maria: After changes overall 5xx 1.4%, timeouts 0.5%, 429s 0.4%. I'll close incident after 2-hour hold. Ticket INC-20260122-NOVA-ERR.
lia: Thanks team. Post-action: add note to onboarding checklist to cap client batch sizes and monitor queue growth.
